hero.subtitle: A {{age}} energetic boy who loves art, LEGO, reading, and sports!

about.title: About Me
about.name: Yibu Zhou
about.description: I'm Yibu Zhou, a friendly, expressive, and imaginative little boy. I love singing, dancing, drawing, crafts, and performing on stage. I enjoy creating my own little worlds with LEGO, getting lost in books, and exploring the world through running and cycling.

cars.title: Toy Cars
cars.description: I love all kinds of toy cars! Racing cars, construction vehicles, emergency vehicles - you name it!

lego.title: LEGO Building
lego.description: I have LEGO class every Monday. I can build from instructions, and I also love creating my own designs with loose bricks, like race cars and storage boxes.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Reading is one of my favorite daily activities. Whether in Chinese or English, listening to stories or looking at pictures, I can get completely immersed in books.

sports.title: Sports
sports.description: I love running! I joined two youth trail races and did well. I've also taken off my training wheels and can ride my bike confidently in open spaces.

artPerformance.title: Art & Performance
artPerformance.description: I'm very interested in singing, dancing, drawing, crafts, and stage performance. Last semester I played a cowboy, and this semester I played a hunter — I perform with confidence and energy!

lego.title: LEGO Creator
lego.description: I can follow instructions to build sets, and I also create my own works with loose bricks, like race cars and a custom storage box.

running.title: Trail Runner
running.description: Joined two youth trail races and achieved great results. I'm becoming more and more confident as I run!

walking.title: Little Hiker
walking.description: Started hiking with mom and dad at age 2, already climbed several mountains!

cycling.title: Cycling Progress
cycling.description: I've taken off the training wheels and can ride well in open areas. I'm still practicing to ride even more smoothly.

calligraphy.title: Calligraphy Certificate
calligraphy.description: Earned Grade 1 Certificate in Hard-Pen Calligraphy. A year of pen-control practice has greatly improved my Chinese writing.

artExhibition.title: Museum Exhibition
artExhibition.description: My artwork 'Swimming Pool' created at the Museum of Art Pudong workshop was exhibited at the museum for over a month — a truly meaningful experience.
